creation.prompt: Edit ONLY the eyes/eyelids/brows and local facial tension of reference 1, the owner-selected Leo S07 portrait base. A sharper but controlled questioning reaction to 'Why were you racing through here without watching where you were going?': one brow raised with a small skeptical crease, amber eyes down toward nearby offscreen Milo on screen-right, slightly tense closed mouth. Mild annoyance, not rage, snarling or frightening aggression. Keep EXACT head pose/angle, skull/muzzle, eye size and spacing, ears/mane curls, neck/shoulders/upper-chest silhouette, visible body extent, crop and image canvas. No zoom, head lift, body rebuild, mirroring or new anatomy. Reference 2 owns canonical identity/material/palette; reference 3 supplies that character's own projected surface guides, not new targets. Preserve intrinsic felt colors and texture. Closed mouth at still boundary despite dialogue; no teeth or speech mouth. Genuine transparent alpha, no environment, props, captions, symbols, shadows or watermark. One output only. A reference constrains generation but does not prove exact pixel identity; preserve surrounding body as closely as possible.
